description: Implement resolve_channel_sender(scope) returning active Person or safe unauthorized. Reuse provider/config/enabled connector validation and People discovery operation already used by message resolve/2, without synthetic Incoming, provider profile fetch or new identity owner. Preserve ordinary message enrichment/legacy identity behavior. Tests first invalid ID/provider/disabled/archived/inactive, connector-local sender and message parity. Owners IdentityResolver; docs channels/engine responsibility references with integration step. Reuse extend existing resolver validation/discovery, no standalone tool or business Action; internal trusted lifecycle.
title: [zaq-pkd.21] Share scoped sender discovery in IdentityResolver
